title: Workspace schema and template contracts
objective: Context configuration, canonical directory rules, entity frontmatter contracts, artifact manifests, task hierarchy, and template generation inputs exist as typed, validated, tested contracts, with the workspace template validated against them.
business_value: WP-200, WP-210, WP-220, and WP-400 need stable workspace and entity contracts; today only context config has a typed model and the template is never validated against its own schemas.
scope: Implement typed Pydantic models for entity frontmatter, task, artifact manifest, and audit-relevant workspace documents in src/workctx/domain/entities.py, tasks.py, artifacts.py (WP-100 owns ids/references/locators/relations file names; do not create those)

Fix schemas/context.schema.json drift: created_at/updated_at must be required, matching ContextConfig; align the schema_version constraint (schema const 1 vs model ge=1) so model and schema express the same rule — the model must reject versions other than 1 with a migration-required error per ADR 0007

Align schemas/entity.schema.json entity_type enum with the canonical vocabulary fixed by decision D-018: exactly evidence, person, team, project, system, service, module, flow, integration, decision, risk, question, task, claim, draft, investigation, incident, observation, artifact (test against this literal list; do not read WP-100's branch)
Define the task ID grammar and parent/subtask/root consistency rules as typed validation (task.schema.json shape plus code rules JSON Schema cannot express)

Add instance validation: template context.yaml validates against context.schema.json; template frontmatter documents validate against their schemas; use a $ref registry so cross-schema references actually resolve in tests
Add frontmatter templates for the remaining entity types that have directories but no template under 99_meta/templates/, at minimum person, decision, risk, question, claim
Declare src/workctx/resources/context_template as the canonical template tree and templates/context as the generated mirror; add a deterministic sync check or generation script and document the rule

Extend template generation inputs: context init must parameterize timestamps and honor kind/profile where doc-01 profiles imply differences; keep changes to services/contexts.py minimal and signature-stable
Add contract-test fixtures per ADR 0008 for every schema you own
non_goals: No SQLite projections (WP-210), no validation engine rewrite (WP-220), no transaction engine (WP-300)
No changes to reference/source-locator/observation/claim schemas (WP-100 owns them)
No CLI framework changes (WP-120); services/contexts.py public function signatures (initialize_context, load_context_config, resolve_context_root, slugify_context_id) are frozen during Wave 1
No tightening of transaction-proposal.schema.json and audit-event.schema.json beyond documented TODO markers (WP-300 owns semantics); record the boundary in your report
deliverables: Schema drift fixes and instance validation with a $ref registry
acceptance_criteria: Template context.yaml and frontmatter documents validate against their schemas in tests, with $refs actually resolved
context.schema.json requires created_at/updated_at and its schema_version rule matches the model's, guarded by positive and negative fixtures per ADR 0008
entity_type enum equals the D-018 19-value list exactly, tested against the literal list (cross-branch equality with WP-100's enum is verified by the lead at integration, not by this order)
Task parent/subtask/root consistency rules are enforced in code with negative tests
Byte-equality or generated-sync between the two template trees is enforced by test, with the canonical direction documented
workctx context init still passes existing tests with unchanged service signatures
security_constraints: Fictional examples only; no secrets; template must keep 98_state ignored and credentials excluded
Do not weaken security_boundary, federated_search, or policy invariants pinned in the model and schema
stop_conditions: Any needed change to frozen service signatures or WP-100-owned files
Any template change that alters the REQUIRED_DIRECTORIES contract in src/workctx/validation/workspace.py (frozen this wave; raise to the lead)
Entity-type vocabulary conflict with WP-100 that the lead has not resolved
